values: [wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Come little Girlfriend
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Come with me
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Your [color=#4f426b]friend[color=#ffffff7f] is waiting
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Steadily...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]The night has come
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]What's left is me
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]To show how happy
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]You
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f] can be.
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]You and I
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Yes, let us run...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]With Hypno
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]You will have such
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=f98d97]fun!
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Now come along
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Come, little one
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffff5a ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Just gaze into my
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ff00655a ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]PENDULUM...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]Now now, little Girlfriend
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]Why do you fight me?
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]Hypno only wants this
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]night,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]One night,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]please...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]I mean no harm,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]No intention to be frightening,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]You'll find that the pendulum,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Can be quite
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]ENLIGHTENING...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]You prickle upon Hypno's resolve,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Yes, it's true.
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]As did your little [color=#4f426b]friend[color=#ffffff7f],
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]I spoke to him too.
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]I led him away, far away,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]He never knew...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]That Hypno ultimately led him,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]To his...
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=12][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ff0000a0 ease=1.0][color=#ff00657f]DOOM.
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]So, little Girlfriend,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Please do not squirm,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Soon now, it may be,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]You'll just have to learn:
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]That resisting the power
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Of Hypno's great force,
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]Is the quickest of ways
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0][color=#ffffff7f]To know just
[wave amp=70.0 freq=3.5][shake rate=20.0 level=10][pulse freq=1.1 color=#ffffffa0 ease=1.0]remorse...
[shake rate=35.0 level=15][color=#ffffff7f]You shall stay with me forever,
